question: What is the category title, version, department name, school name, total number of courses for each course level, and the total number of degree-granting courses for each CIP category code?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cip_lookup" AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(program_code AS VARCHAR) AS program_code, CAST(category_code AS VARCHAR) AS category_code, category_title, CAST(version AS VARCHAR) AS version FROM beaver."CIP"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "courses_by_cip" AS SELECT course AS course, department_name AS department_name, school_name AS school_name, course_level AS course_level, CAST(cip_program_code AS VARCHAR) AS cip_program_code, is_degree_granting AS is_degree_granting FROM beaver."SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cip_lookup" AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(program_code AS VARCHAR) AS program_code, CAST(category_code AS VARCHAR) AS category_code, CAST(category_title AS VARCHAR) AS category_title, CAST(version AS VARCHAR) AS version FROM beaver."CIP"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "courses_by_cip" AS SELECT CAST(course AS VARCHAR) AS course, CAST(department_name AS VARCHAR) AS department_name, CAST(school_name AS VARCHAR) AS school_name, CAST(course_level AS VARCHAR) AS course_level, CAST(cip_program_code AS VARCHAR) AS cip_program_code, CAST(is_degree_granting AS VARCHAR) AS is_degree_granting FROM beaver."SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cip_lookup" AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('program_code'), ('category_code'), ('category_title'), ('version')) AS t(columns)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "courses_by_cip" AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('course'), ('department_name'), ('school_name'), ('course_level'), ('cip_program_code'), ('is_degree_granting')) AS t(columns)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    c.category_title AS category_title,
    CAST(c.version AS BIGINT) AS version,
    scd.department_name AS department_name,
    scd.school_name AS school_name,
    scd.course_level AS course_level,
    c.category_code AS category_code,
    scd.course AS course,
    scd.is_degree_granting AS is_degree_granting
  FROM courses_by_cip scd
  JOIN cip_lookup c
    ON CAST(scd.cip_program_code AS VARCHAR) = CAST(c.program_code AS VARCHAR)
)
SELECT 
  category_title,
  version,
  department_name,
  school_name,
  course_level,
  category_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT course) AS total_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(is_degree_granting,'')) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE','T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
ORDER BY category_code, department_name, school_name, course_level

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
-- Try robust name matching via COALESCE of alternative column spellings
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    -- course id
    COALESCE(course, COURSE, subject_id, SUBJECT_ID) AS course,
    -- department and school
    COALESCE(department_name, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS department_name,
    COALESCE(school_name, SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
    -- course level
    COALESCE(course_level, COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level,
    -- cip program code and degree flag
    COALESCE(cip_program_code, CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, program_code, PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code,
    COALESCE(is_degree_granting, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS is_degree_granting
  FROM courses_by_cip
), cip AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(program_code, PROGRAM_CODE) AS program_code,
    COALESCE(category_code, CATEGORY_CODE) AS category_code,
    COALESCE(category_title, CATEGORY_TITLE) AS category_title,
    COALESCE(version, VERSION) AS version
  FROM cip_lookup
), joined AS (
  SELECT 
    c.category_title,
    CAST(c.version AS BIGINT) AS version,
    b.department_name,
    b.school_name,
    b.course_level,
    c.category_code,
    b.course,
    b.is_degree_granting
  FROM base b
  JOIN cip c
    ON CAST(b.cip_program_code AS VARCHAR) = CAST(c.program_code AS VARCHAR)
)
SELECT 
  category_title,
  version,
  department_name,
  school_name,
  course_level,
  category_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT course) AS total_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(is_degree_granting,'')) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE','T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
ORDER BY category_code, department_name, school_name, course_level
